error.courseEnrolUrl: The join link must be an http(s) URL, or leave it empty.
error.lessonChanged: This lesson changed after you opened it (another save or an Obsidian sync). Reload it, then make your change again.
error.partnerNameTaken: A partner with this name already exists.
error.partnerUrl: Website and logo must be http(s) URLs, or leave them empty.
error.versionSource: Copy lessons from a version of this course.
error.versionInUse: Cannot delete a version that groups or active links still use.
error.versionNotDraft: Only draft versions can be deleted.
error.versionDraftEmpty: This version has no lessons to preview yet.

list.groupCopies: {count, plural, one {# group with its own copy} other {# groups with its own copy}}
list.emptyText: A course holds the lessons your groups start from.

course.publishedHint: The course’s own lessons: new groups start from them. Groups with their own copy keep theirs.
course.draftHint: A draft: learners don’t see it until it is published.
course.emptyText: Make the course’s first version below, then add its lessons.

newCourse.title: New course
newCourse.subtitle: Create the course, then add lessons from the course page.

form.title: Title
form.slugHint: Used in links. Updates from the title; you can change it.
form.summaryHint: What the course is for and who it is for. Learners see it on their course page, and AI uses it as context when it drafts changes.
form.summaryPlaceholder: Build, test and ship one production web app end to end.
form.githubHint: Shown to learners. Must be an https://github.com/… URL.
form.languageHint: Learners can still pick their own language on the page.
form.partnersHint: Learners see them under “In partnership with”, in this order. A group can list its own instead.
form.websiteHint: If your own site shows your courses through the Chalkenso API, these decide how this one appears there.
form.allLessonsFree: Every lesson can be read without a learner link
form.freeLessonsHint: How many lessons, from the start, anyone can read. The rest need a learner link.
form.outcomePlaceholder: Build and ship a web app end to end
form.joinHint: Where “Join” leads after the free lessons. With the site default, your website decides (a contact page, say).
form.joinPartnerNoWebsite: This partner has no website yet: add one under Settings → Partners, or the button uses the site default.
form.joinPartnerHint: The button leads to the partner’s website.
form.joinLinkHint: Where people sign up for the next group, e.g. the course’s enrolment page.

cover.label: Cover image
cover.later: You can add a cover once the course is created.
cover.hint: A screenshot or GIF of what learners build, ideally 1200×630. Your website shows it on the course card and page.
cover.altPlaceholder: What the cover shows, for people who can't see it

feedback.emptyHint: Plan an improvement from feedback on the course’s own lessons, or accept a group’s suggestion (Groups).
feedback.emptyOwn: Nothing open on the course’s own lessons.
feedback.emptyAll: Nothing open. Feedback from every group of this course shows here.
feedback.changesHint: Changes to the course’s own lessons. A group’s own changes are on its page.

version.groupCopyFrom: the group’s own copy, made from {version}
version.groupCopyFromDeleted: the group’s own copy, made from a deleted course version
version.groupCopyNotice: This is {name}'s own copy. Changes here only reach that group; the course's own lessons stay as they are.

preview.eyebrow: Team preview · select text to add a note
preview.eyebrowGroup: Team preview for {name} · select text to add a note

versions.emptyText: Make the first version to start writing lessons.
versions.readBy: {count, plural, one {read by # group} other {read by # groups}}
versions.copiesMade: {count, plural, one {# group copy made from it} other {# group copies made from it}}
versions.publishDescription: This version will be published and served to the groups assigned to it.
versions.unpublishDescription: This version will be moved back to draft and will stop being served through live access links.
versions.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the version and all of its lessons. This action cannot be undone.
versions.deleteNamedDescription: This permanently deletes “{label}” and all of its lessons. This action cannot be undone.

create.label: Label
create.labelHint: Optional. Defaults to the next version number (e.g. v2).
create.duplicateHint: Optional. Copy every lesson from an existing version to start from.

lessons.imagesToUpload: {count, plural, one {# image to upload} other {# images to upload}}
lessons.emptySection: No lessons in this section yet. Pick it under Section in a lesson’s Details.

arcs.title: Section title
arcs.descriptionHint: Optional. Shown under the section heading on the course page.
arcs.descriptionPlaceholder: What this part of the course covers.
arcs.empty: No sections yet. Add one to group this version’s lessons into arcs.
arcs.deleteDescription: This deletes the section. This action cannot be undone.
arcs.deleteWithLessons: This deletes the section. Its {count} lesson(s) stay in the version but become ungrouped.

previewLinks.intro: Share this version, drafts included, with anyone. Preview links are read-only like group links; a one-time link only works in the first browser that opens it.
previewLinks.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the link. Try again.
previewLinks.deleteFailed: Could not delete the link. Try again.
previewLinks.deleteDescription: This link will be permanently removed. Comments left through it are kept. This cannot be undone.
previewLinks.deleteNamedDescription: “{label}” will be permanently removed. Comments left through it are kept. This cannot be undone.

modal.title: Preview link
modal.description: Read-only link to this version, drafts included. The link is copied when created.
modal.oneTime: One-time: works only in the first browser that opens it
modal.expiresHint: Must be opened before this; also ends access for whoever opened it.
modal.createFailed: Could not create the link. Try again.

forks.accepted: accepted · being made in the course’s lessons
forks.doneInGroup: Done in the group: also for the course?

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Schools, companies and sponsors you teach with. Add one once, then pick it on any course or group: learners see it under “In partnership with”.
partners.emptyText: Add the schools and companies you teach with. Courses and groups list them under “In partnership with”, and a course's Join button can lead to a partner's website.
partners.newSubtitle: Add it once, then pick it on any course or group.
partners.unused: No course or group lists this partner yet. Pick it in a course's or group's settings.

form.name: Name
form.websiteHint: Where the partner's name links to. A course's Join button can lead here too.
form.logoHint: An image on the web, best a single-colour logo on a transparent background.
form.descriptionHint: Optional. A line about the partner, for websites that show one.

delete.title: Delete this partner?
delete.description: Courses and groups stop showing “{name}”, and Join buttons that led to its website go back to the site default. This can't be undone.

list.none: No partners yet. Add them under <link>Settings → Partners</link>.

deleteTask.confirmWithFeedback: Delete this improvement and the feedback it was made from, for good?

actions.lessonChanged: This lesson changed after you opened it (a sync from Obsidian, or someone else saved it), so nothing was saved. Copy your changes, reload the page to get the new text, and apply them again.
actions.versionPublished: {count, plural, one {Version published with all # lesson.} other {Version published with all # lessons.}}
actions.groupCopyStaysPublished: A group’s copy stays published. Close it from the group’s Settings instead.
actions.previewStillLive: Only revoked or expired preview links can be deleted.
actions.diagramNotSaved: A new diagram couldn't be saved, so nothing was saved. Try again, or skip the diagram.

upload.unsafeSvg: This SVG has nothing left to show once its scripts and outside links are taken out.
